scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n events,ai,filer,scanner,designer,gateway,app -c gray,blue,red,magenta,yellow,cyan,green "pnpm run dev:events" "pnpm run dev:ai" "pnpm run dev:filer" "pnpm run dev:scanner" "pnpm run dev:designer" "pnpm run dev:gateway" "pnpm run dev:app"
scripts.dev:events: nodemon --quiet --watch services/events --watch proto --ext go --signal SIGTERM --exec "go run ./services/events/cmd/events"
scripts.dev:filer: nodemon --quiet --watch services/filer --watch proto --ext go --signal SIGTERM --exec "go run ./services/filer/cmd/filer"
scripts.dev:ai: nodemon --quiet --watch services/ai --watch proto --watch llm --ext go --signal SIGTERM --exec "go run ./services/ai/cmd/ai"
scripts.dev:scanner: nodemon --quiet --watch services/scanner --watch plugins --watch proto --ext go --signal SIGTERM --exec "go run ./services/scanner/cmd/scanner"
scripts.dev:designer: nodemon --quiet --watch services/designer --watch proto --ext go --signal SIGTERM --exec "go run ./services/designer/cmd/designer"
scripts.dev:gateway: nodemon --quiet --watch services/gateway --watch proto --ext go --signal SIGTERM --exec "go run ./services/gateway/cmd/gateway"
